test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title for the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1** i.e. **Grapes and its uses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **passage discusses** various aspects of grapes, including where they are grown, their use in wine-making, the drying process to make raisins, and the different varieties grown.
 
• **It covers** multiple uses of grapes: fresh consumption (table grapes), wine production, and raisin production.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Grapes and its uses'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Grapes and world. This is too vague and does not specifically highlight the comprehensive discussion on the uses of grapes.
 
• **Option 3:** Wine making. While the passage does mention wine-making, it is not solely about this topic; it also covers other uses of grapes such as making raisins.
 
• **Option 4: **Varieties of grapes. Although different varieties of grapes are mentioned, this is only a part of the broader discussion in the passage.
